issue: MECHANISM_SPACE attribution vocabulary still contains the verified-versus-matched evidence ambiguity
status: RECORDED_NOT_FIXED_IN_R517 (measurement-hygiene only; directive Phase 9: do not combine with the retrieval performance optimization)
detail: The lean mechanism-space path's runtime_attribution funnel counts 'verified_evidence_items' but the underlying construction is R453_LEAN_REUSE_FREEZE_VERIFY_FACTS — matched structured evidence derived deterministically from frozen records joined to VERIFY classification, not independently verified evidence in the v1.0.0 extraction sense. Calling it 'verified' overstates the epistemic status; the correct label is 'matched structured evidence' or 'structured items'.
why_not_fixed_now: Directive Phase 9 explicitly forbids combining this hygiene fix with the retrieval optimization (one optimization per round; measurement hygiene is a separate measurement-only change). Fixing the vocabulary now would conflate two changes and void the controlled performance comparison.
scheduled_correction: Measurement-only change in a follow-up round: rename the field and its funnel derivation basis without altering any gate, threshold, or candidate-counting semantics; update the attribution instrument version and the spec's funnel description accordingly; re-verify the 11-test attribution battery passes with the new label.
disclosure: The ambiguity does not affect the RETRIEVE attribution/optimization in this round (separate subsystem), but it does mean MECHANISM_SPACE funnel counts must be read as 'structured-items matched' not 'independently verified' until the correction lands.
